trigger: Choose clear point in range; each creature with any part of its footprint within 20-ft sphere and line of effect
choices: Pick row, column and altitude, then roll shared damage with Dexterity half and Fire resistance; ignite flammable unattended objects

trigger: Choose clear point in range; each reached creature's footprint in a 10-ft sphere
choices: Shared Thunder damage, Constitution half for creatures, full damage to unattended nonmagical gear; Construct save disadvantage irrelevant to existing combatants
26 lattice directions; Fire damage after Dexterity save, ignite flammable unattended objects only

trigger: 15-ft cube whose rear face contains caster origin
choices: 26 directions and 25 lateral/vertical face placements; Constitution half, push each failing creature 10 ft; push wholly covered unsecured gear even without creature recipients, no opportunity attack
Each creature in square when cast other than caster rolls Strength or is restrained; an action with Athletics frees; creates difficult terrain only on affected floor plane

trigger: 40-ft cylinder appears, moves into space, entered by creature, or occupied when creature ends its turn
cost: Action, slot 2+ and concentration; later Magic action moves beam up to 60 ft
choices: Choose a spatial origin/reposition; Constitution half vs Radiant; failed save reverts Wild Shape and blocks reshaping until exit; each actual creature turn independent including companions

trigger: 15-ft emanation appears, overlaps a newly entered creature, or a creature ends turn in it
choices: Designate exempt creatures at cast; fixed good/neutral Life preset uses Radiant per alignment; Wisdom half; speed halved within emanation; at most one save per creature per actual turn

trigger: Area heavily obscures; each creature starts its actual turn inside sphere
choices: Constitution save with Dwarven poison advantage where applicable; Poisoned failure suppresses action and bonus for current turn; actual elevation and intervening cloud affect sight

trigger: Touch one willing creature; later recipient takes Magic action on own turn
cost: Bonus Action, slot 2+ and concentration; each exhale Magic action
choices: Choose element, recipient and consent where needed; 26 directions from actual recipient’s mouth; Dexterity half, typed resistance; companions can repeat on their own turns

trigger: Selected cube appears briefly; a creature must see pattern
choices: Each creature in footprint making Wisdom save; fail leaves Charmed/Incapacitated and speed 0. An affected creature wakes separately on damage or an adjacent creature’s action
Choose damage subset and separate single heal recipient; Constitution half; hidden positions are not inferred from menu choices

trigger: A visible creature makes a damage roll within 60 ft
cost: Reaction and one Bardic Inspiration use if accepted
choices: Offer before damage is applied and before save halving; recurring event resumes original decision/turn continuation

trigger: Place within 60 ft; later turns may move up to 20 ft
cost: Bonus Action, slot 2+ and concentration; later Bonus Action only
choices: 3D placement; optional nearby creature or a guessed space when unseen; footprint reach and cover from the weapon; Force 1d8 + WIS, +1d8 per extra rank

trigger: 30-ft cone; each creature makes a Wisdom save
cost: Action, slot 3 and concentration; mandatory Dash when an escape route exists
choices: Drop held gear; frighten players and companions; flee via safest 3D routes with ground, climb, and flight costs from the visible or last-seen caster; repeat Wisdom save without line of sight; resolve separately per creature

trigger: 15-ft sphere, 60-ft range; start of turn or first entry that turn
choices: Charisma saves for each creature; failed save binds only while within this cast’s sphere. Arena has no dialog action.

trigger: Self; select and optionally replace one mode
cost: Action, slot 2+ and concentration; later Magic action
choices: Aquatic adaptation, appearance change, or one of four growths. Growth only changes unarmed damage, d6 plus casting modifier and appropriate damage type; dry arena has no swimming or identity checks.

rule_source: SRD 5.2 · Fear, Dissonant Whispers, Suggestion and individual area spells
trigger: Plan a route through a known persistent danger
cost: Use the originating action or reaction where applicable
choices: Check Moonbeam, Spirit Guardians and Stinking Cloud at each elevation. Forecast only visible/own spell effects and known footprints; preserve Spirit Guardians exemptions.

rule_source: SRD 5.2 · Areas of Effect and vision
trigger: A persistent spell field becomes perceivable
choices: Show center, elevation and extent for a visible fixed field even when its source cannot be seen. A creature-bound emanation requires actual sight of the caster.
